panels.title: Formulas per family (latest day in range)

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND ('__all' IN ($family) OR formula_family IN ($family))
)
SELECT formula_family, count(*)::BIGINT AS formulas
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY min(formula_id)

panels.title: Published formulas per day by family

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, formula_family, count(*)::BIGINT AS formulas
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  AND ('__all' IN ($family) OR formula_family IN ($family))
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, formula_family

panels.title: Formula changes vs previous published day (added / removed / renamed)

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND ('__all' IN ($family) OR formula_family IN ($family))
),
days AS (
  SELECT trad_dt, lag(trad_dt) OVER (ORDER BY trad_dt) AS prev_dt
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT trad_dt FROM d)
),
cur AS (
  SELECT d.*
  FROM d
  JOIN days USING (trad_dt)
  WHERE days.prev_dt IS NOT NULL
),
prv AS (
  SELECT days.trad_dt, d.formula_id, d.formula_name, d.formula_family
  FROM days
  JOIN d ON d.trad_dt = days.prev_dt
)
SELECT coalesce(c.trad_dt, p.trad_dt) AS trad_dt,
  CASE
    WHEN p.formula_id IS NULL THEN 'added'
    WHEN c.formula_id IS NULL THEN 'removed'
    ELSE 'renamed'
  END AS change,
  coalesce(c.formula_id, p.formula_id) AS formula_id,
  coalesce(c.formula_family, p.formula_family) AS formula_family,
  p.formula_name AS prev_formula_name,
  c.formula_name AS formula_name
FROM cur c
FULL JOIN prv p
  ON c.trad_dt = p.trad_dt
  AND c.formula_id = p.formula_id
WHERE p.formula_id IS NULL
  OR c.formula_id IS NULL
  OR c.formula_name <> p.formula_name
ORDER BY trad_dt DESC, formula_id
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Risk formula catalog (latest day in range)

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND ('__all' IN ($family) OR formula_family IN ($family))
),
hist AS (
  SELECT formula_id, min(trad_dt) AS first_seen
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_risk_formulas/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  GROUP BY formula_id
)
SELECT d.formula_id,
  d.formula_family,
  d.formula_name,
  hist.first_seen
FROM d
JOIN hist USING (formula_id)
WHERE d.trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
ORDER BY d.formula_id
